findings.desc: AGENTS.md / B-d854 checklist evidence — acceptance-blocking missing proof: CHK-001:happy:0 and CHK-003:happy:0 claim a 26-row RED-to-GREEN audit, but rg -n "26-row|AGENTS_RED_GREEN|RED_GREEN" .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-d854 AGENTS.md finds only summary prose in checklist.json; there is no row-by-row ledger, command, captured RED output, captured GREEN output, or signed receipt mapping each of the 26 asserted corrections to an authoritative source. The existing mechanical checks cover Unicode, a small token inventory, and 20 command names, not the claimed 26 behavioral rows. Because the user explicitly requested evidence that the previously identified issues were RED then GREEN, this unsupported aggregate claim blocks acceptance. Add a reproducible 26-row artifact/evidence record and bind its exact command/output to current AGENTS.md before re-review. severity: high

AGENTS.md:55-58 conflicts with the current canonical reviewer contract. The guide says Never directly read or write Story or fixture JSON, while review_run_start for this same Story requires the reviewer to read .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-d854/background.md, plan.md, and checklist.json. The managed thin block at AGENTS.md:9 correctly prohibits direct edits only, and direct reads do not bypass signatures, hashes, locks, receipts, or lifecycle mutation validation. This overbroad prohibition makes a reviewer violate AGENTS.md in order to satisfy the canonical role prompt and therefore fails the requested prompt-consistency audit. Narrow the rule to direct writes/mutations, and state that bounded read-only reviewer inputs named by a canonical prompt are permitted; retain CLI reads for ordinary state inspection. severity: high

AGENTS.md:18-23 / Story verification evidence — acceptance requires a claim-by-claim audit ledger and the user specifically asked whether every previously identified issue has RED then GREEN proof. The only persisted docs_check note says “the 26-row RED/GREEN matrix passed” and lists a few broad source ranges, but no 26 rows, per-row baseline failure, final pass condition, authoritative citation, command, exit code, or captured output are present. A reviewer cannot reproduce or inspect the claimed matrix, so the proof request is not delivered even though the final wording appears to address the 24 major and 2 low-priority groups. Fix by recording and presenting the actual 26-row RED→GREEN ledger, with each row independently tied to the baseline line, final line, authority and runnable evidence.

AGENTS.md:16-566 — “translate the complete root AGENTS.md” was implemented as an undocumented consolidation, not a fully accounted translation. The baseline has 598 lines/32 fences/41 table rows/11 blockquotes; the final has 566/20/21/0. A deterministic command inventory finds 14 still-current repository-local CLI examples removed from runnable guidance (aux_detail, aux_diagnose, aux_scan, aux_sync, aux_trace, decision_get, decision_set, fixture_batch_add, gap_log, story_create, test_fixture, test_story, understanding_get, understanding_set; each --help exits 0). The evidence supplies only the blanket sentence “obsolete and duplicate legacy sections consolidated” rather than listing each intentional removal and justification, contrary to CHK-002:edge:0 and the complete-translation request. Restore faithful English coverage or provide a complete itemized audit proving every deletion is an authorized consistency correction rather than lost content.

AGENTS.md:492-530 / CHK-001:adversarial:0 and CHK-003:adversarial:0 evidence — the active-command checker is a false-green oracle for exact examples. Its regex retains only a command name (plus the codex subcommand), then invokes `<command> --help`; it discards every documented argument and never runs concrete read-only examples or validates mutating payloads in a disposable repository/schema path. Therefore an example with a nonexistent flag, wrong payload field, or invalid value would still pass. This fails the pinned intent that every active example be operational and that read-only/mutating examples be exercised safely. Replace it with an extractor that validates each complete example and include a deliberately malformed-argument mutation in addition to the nonexistent-command sentinel.
